records.c: Sets the I/O and RAM configuration, switches off the CIA interrupts, enables the raster interrupt on line 0, and points the IRQ vector at the sprite multiplexer at $0622
Raster interrupt for one of the two screen buffers: counts down $23, and at each stop gives a pair of sprites their next Y position and bumps their sprite pointers in the screen at $8BF8
Last stop of a frame: sets the first row of sprite positions, resets the eight sprite pointers to their first frames and restarts the stop counter at 13
The same sprite multiplexer for the other screen buffer, whose sprite pointers are at $CBF8 and whose stop tables are at $01BB-$01DE
Last stop of a frame for the second buffer: same reset as the first, using the tables at $01BB
Flips bit 0 of $DD00, which selects the VIC-II bank, so the buffer just drawn is shown and the other is drawn next
Takes the new IRQ vector for the shown buffer from the pair of tables at $0165 and $0167
Waits for the fire button on port 1 to be pressed and then released, with the title screen showing
Selects keyboard column 0 and reads $DC01 bit 4, which is the fire button of joystick port 1; the carry flag comes back set while the button is up and clear while it is held
Reads joystick port 2 from $DC00, inverts it so a pressed direction is 1, and looks the result up in the table at $1AC4

Sound effect player: sets the volume to 15 and, while a sound is active in $1208, writes frequency, pulse, envelope and waveform values for each voice from the tables at $2B06-$2B2E, indexed by the sound number
